newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nikon shares surge to record high.
newsitem.headline: Nikon shares surge to record high.

text.p: Shares of Nikon Corp rallied to an all-time high on Wednesday, helped by a newspaper report that Japanese manufacturers of semiconductor-producing equipment will boost their output, traders said.
Shares of Nikon, a major camera maker that also produces semiconductor-related equipment, briefly hit a record high of 2,240 yen, dipped and rose back to that figure by 0201 GMT.
Its trading volume was 2.202 million shares.

The newspaper report said the manufacturers include Nikon, and said it would expand its capacity to boost its output of steppers, which put chip circuits on to wafers, to 500 units a year from a current 200 units.
